conviction_note: The Q3 numbers are new, there is no guidance (Byggmax gives none), coverage is two analysts and the stock moved +12.3% and -15.7% on the last two Q3 reports, so abs_move is 7.5. The lean is mildly negative (p_up 45) because SCB's own sector series shows Swedish building-materials retail slowing to +5.4% in Jul-Aug while Byggmax has trailed that series by 3-7 points for three quarters running, which points to sales below the SEK 2,049M consensus. A gross margin that has risen every quarter and a strong September at Clas Ohlson partly offset it. Findings sum to -0.7 and the scaled number is -0.75; they agree in sign and size, and both are small because the main evidence is a sector proxy, not a company number.

findings.finding: SCB's own retail series for building, hardware and paint stores (SNI 47.52, current prices) grew +9.3% y/y in Q2 2026 but slowed to +6.8% in July and +3.9% in August (+5.4% for Jul-Aug). Byggmax Sweden trailed that series by -2.9 pts in Q3 2025 (+0.7% vs +3.6%), -5.6 in Q1 2026 (-5.3% vs +0.3%) and -6.9 in Q2 2026 (+2.4% vs +9.3%). Carrying even the smallest gap forward gives Swedish sales of roughly -1.5% to +2.5% and group sales of about SEK 2,000-2,035M including about +6% NOK translation on Other Nordic, which is below the SEK 2,049M consensus. That consensus implies about 3.5% organic growth, a gap to the sector that would have to close sharply.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 sales came in about 5% below the expected SEK 2,054M (EBITA 272 vs 281 expected) and the stock fell 15.74% on 2025-10-24. Q1 2026 sales missed by about 5% and the stock fell 3.77% on 2026-04-17. Q2 2026 beat on EPS and the stock rose 2.98% on 2026-07-10.
findings.original_quote: Detaljhandelns omsättning efter näringsgren SNI 2007, index 2021=100 -- 47.52 'butiker för bygg-, järn- och vvs-varor samt färger och glas', löpande priser: 2025M07 101.4, 2025M08 97.7; 2026M07 108.3, 2026M08 101.5; Byggmax Q2 2026: 'Net sales in Sweden increased by 2.4 percent'
findings.why_not_priced: Two analysts cover the name. The single EPS estimate was raised 3.59 to 3.68 in the last week, and revenue consensus at +5.1% assumes Byggmax closes most of a share gap that has widened for three straight quarters. If the market had priced the SCB slowdown and the gap, revenue estimates would sit nearer SEK 2,000M and the stock would not have run +5.2% over five sessions into the print. The register carries no short building against it.
findings.independence: Byggmaterialhandlarna's Byggmaterialindex for Q2 2026 (B2C turnover +10.3%) independently confirms the size of the Q2 market Byggmax lagged: https://www.mynewsdesk.com/se/byggmaterialhandlarna/pressreleases/byggmarknaden-tar-positiva-kliv-under-det-andra-kvartalet-2026-3460009. It says nothing about Jul-Aug, so the deceleration rests on SCB alone.

findings.finding: Byggmax's gross margin has risen y/y in each of the last three reported quarters: Q3 2025 37.4% (35.9), Q1 2026 36.1% (35.0), Q2 2026 35.1% (34.2). In Q2 2026 the drivers were supplier cash discounts and mix, even though early payment of purchased goods was already in the 2025 base. If Q3 repeats about +1 pt on the 37.4% comparison, EPS reaches about 3.68 even on sales near SEK 2,015M. Consensus EPS at the consensus sales figure needs only about +0.3 pt.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 gross margin beat (37.4% vs 36.4% expected) did not save the stock from a -15.74% day on the sales/EBITA miss; Q2 2026 margin-led EPS beat: +2.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: a +13% EPS consensus on +5% sales already assumes some operating leverage. What is not in the bar is a full repeat of the roughly 1-pt annual margin step against a record comparison, which is why the finding is small. The single EPS estimate gives no read on how much margin the market assumes.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 report, which shows the same drivers and the comparison base: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a94fec2410f87db45a4d7c9a944b2cf51. This is the same issuer, so it is not independent of the claim.

findings.finding: Clas Ohlson, a Nordic hardware and home retailer with an overlapping customer base, reported September 2026 sales +19% (organic +12%, Sweden organic +11%, Norway +8%) and May-September organic +11%. September consumer demand in hardware/home was firm after SCB's softer August, which pushes against reading the August deceleration as the trend for the whole quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed Byggmax reaction to a peer read-through. Clas Ohlson's own LFL ran far ahead of Byggmax's (+1.4% LFL in Q2), so the peer has been a poor predictor of Byggmax sales.

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / 'understatement': abs_move_pct raised from 6.5 to 7.5. The numbers are new, coverage is two analysts and the last two Q3 reports moved +12.3% and -15.7%; the sign uncertainty stays in p_up 45.
'Size on the name's own reaction distribution': finding 1 moved from -1.8 to -2.0, given this name's -15.7% on a Q3 sales miss. It stays small because it is a sector proxy and not a company number.

'The move is in the guide' / pre-release check: Byggmax gives no guidance and has issued no trading update or vinstvarning, so the release carries new numbers and no guidance event. That confirmed the base rate and changed no finding.
